version: minds-0.5 (2026-10-05: generator minds for the forced-pick pass, effort medium)
note: Roster registry for glyph-sequence-perception. Adapter specs copied from the archived judges-v1.json; family and mode added. family = LLM family for universality; mode = sheet (several presentations per call) or single (one per call). Copied into refactored/ on 2026-10-05. Glimmer (muse) is not on the roster: it was paused in r003 of the triad era (Joseph: pause glimmer, skip local models for now).

context_residue.claude: claude -p with --tools '' --strict-mcp-config (no MCP), --setting-sources '' and --system-prompt override. Verified 2026-10-03: the judge sees no CLAUDE.md content and nothing about glyphs; it DOES see an account-level note giving the user's email address (asked directly, sonnet-5-5 reported it). Not removable from this CLI; judged harmless to glyph perception. Thinking budget: until 2026-10-05 the judges inherited MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=31000 from the launching shell (unrecorded; very likely true of the triad era too); since then it is set per mind here and recorded in each ledger row's judge spec.
context_residue.grok: grok -p under an isolated HOME holding only a symlink to ~/.grok/auth.json and a minimal config (no arch-expert agent, no ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, no skills, no memory); --system-prompt-override, --tools '', no subagents, no web. Verified 2026-10-03: `grok inspect` shows 0 project instructions; judge reports no Joseph/glyph context. Grok's own built-in harness preamble (~13.5k input tokens) remains and cannot be stripped from the CLI.
context_residue.codex: codex exec under an isolated CODEX_HOME holding only a symlink to ~/.codex/auth.json (no AGENTS.md, memories, rules, skills); --ephemeral, read-only sandbox. No system-prompt override exists, so the study system line is prepended to the user turn. Codex's built-in agent preamble (~13k input tokens) remains. Verified 2026-10-03: judge reports no Joseph/glyph context.
context_residue.agy: Gemini via the Antigravity CLI (agy -p), run in an empty cwd; HOME not isolated (agy's knowledge/brain stores exist under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli). Verified 2026-10-03: judge reports no Joseph/glyph context. Study system line prepended to the user turn; agy harness preamble (~12k tokens) remains.
context_residue.ollama: local /api/chat with the study system prompt only; temperature 0, seed 0.
context_residue.llamacpp: local llama-server, study system prompt plus the model's reasoning-strength line; no tools.

roster.note: Core minds answer every sheet; each second mind is added to a sheet with probability second_share (fated). Claude has two core minds, so universality is computed per family. From c002: haiku45nt (thinking off) is core and haiku45 (thinking on) a second mind, so the reasoned condition stays sampled (2026-10-05, the independent session's call, for Joseph to overturn). Reasoners answer only reasoned-pass sheets (generation at felt ends; METHODOLOGY s4). Generators answer only forced-pick sheets (METHODOLOGY s4a; Joseph: 'with effort set to normal (not low) for *generating* / creative work'): the core models at medium effort, thinking allowed.

glimmer30b-sheet.note: Meta Muse Glimmer 30B (GGUF k-quant dynamic, Joseph's T7 copy) via llama.cpp llama-server b10358 with DFlash drafter; 'Reasoning strength: low' appended to the study system prompt per the model's control convention; temperature 0. Added 2026-10-03 at Joseph's suggestion (exploratory, key datapoints only). Sheet-mode variant: max_tokens 6000 so the reasoning plus a 40-item JSON answer fits.

haiku45nt.note: Haiku with thinking off (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0): ~0 thinking tokens and ~2.4 s a sheet, against ~6k and ~56 s with the 31000 budget every earlier Claude answer inherited from Joseph's shell. Closer to recognition than retrieval, and noisier (spikes/thinking-felt-2026-10-05). The same lever does NOT reach claude-sonnet-5-5, which thinks ~600 tokens either way.

sonnet55r.note: The reasoned pass (2026-10-05): Sonnet with thinking and utf-mcp's four read-only Unicode lookup tools (~/src/arch/firmatum/utils/utf-mcp, verified), asked to reason and look things up at sequence ends where first-impression minds stopped. Its answers are candidates, never pooled with first impressions; what it looked up is copied into each ledger row. Effort medium: chosen without evidence.

sonnet55g.note: The generator pass (METHODOLOGY s4a, 2026-10-05): forced single-symbol picks with reasoning, sampled. Effort medium for 'normal (not low)', Joseph's words; the thinking budget 31000 as for the other thinking minds.

haiku45g.note: The generator pass (METHODOLOGY s4a, 2026-10-05): forced single-symbol picks with reasoning, sampled. Effort medium for 'normal (not low)', Joseph's words; the thinking budget 31000 as for the other thinking minds.

grok46g.note: The generator pass (METHODOLOGY s4a, 2026-10-05): forced single-symbol picks with reasoning, sampled. Effort medium for 'normal (not low)', Joseph's words; the thinking budget 31000 as for the other thinking minds. Timeout 1800 s from 2026-10-06 ~17:30 (default 600): at medium effort its calls take a median 164 s, p90 394 s, and 216 of its first 877 (25%) hit the 600 s limit, against 1.4% for grok46; timeouts count as attempts, so the hardest contexts were being dropped.

gemini38flashg.note: The generator pass (METHODOLOGY s4a, 2026-10-05): forced single-symbol picks with reasoning, sampled. Effort medium for 'normal (not low)', Joseph's words; the thinking budget 31000 as for the other thinking minds. agy names the effort in the model id.
